description: A Level-0 publisher — a CMS or wiki export with no engine — publishes the well-known file with the linkset member alone: it has no ledger, so no ledger_head, and no graph.nq, so no hash of one. AGSC-06-08a makes integrity optional at Level 0 and permits an integrity block that omits ledger_head; Levels 2 and 3 still require the full block of AGSC-06-08, which disc-0001 pins. Without this relaxation no CMS export could ever be Level 0, and the D50 promise would fail at its first artifact.
